cards.title: Barrow-wight Stalker
cards.gameText: Enduring. Each [WRAITH] Wraith cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes). Shadow: Remove a burden to play a [WRAITH] Wraith. That minion's twilight cost is -2.
cards.lore: “The icy touch froze his bones, and he remembered no more.”

cards.title: Candle Corpses
cards.gameText: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another [WRAITH] Wraith and remove (2) to wound that companion.
cards.lore: “...here and there they twisted like ghostly sheets unfurled by hidden hands.”

cards.title: Spirit of Dread
cards.gameText: Enduring. While you can spot another [WRAITH] Wraith, wounds cannot be healed and burdens can not be removed (except by Wraiths). Skirmish: Exert Spirit of Dread to make another [WRAITH] Wraith strength +1.
cards.lore: “...across their three necks lay one long naked sword.”

cards.title: Undead of Angmar
cards.gameText: Enduring. While you can spot another [WRAITH] Wraith, each wounded companion is resistance -2. Shadow: Exert Undead of Angmar twice to play a [WRAITH] Wraith from your draw deck, then reshuffle.
cards.lore: “In the dark there was a snarling noise.”
